comparator.name: International Bachelor Communication and Media
comparator.route: International Communication & Business and Creative Industries & Audiences focus areas with minor
comparator.sourceNotes: The 20 August 2026 adopted Dutch OER (controlling in ambiguity) and English TER, Appendix 8 pp36–37, visibly match their extracted text. For entrants from 2026, both print BA1 60 EC plus BA2/3 common requirements 60 EC, two focus areas 20 EC and minor/elective choice 35 EC: 175 itemised EC despite a stated 180-EC grand total. The preceding 2025-and-earlier section separately specifies a 5-EC research workshop and another 5-EC specialisation course; those cannot be imported selectively into the new-cohort table. Article4.5 still requires the BA2 research workshop before the thesis, but does not establish its current entrant credit allocation outside the new focus-area total. The general programme webpage retains six outgoing focus areas and a research-workshop description, without resolving the new-cohort missing credit allocation; the linked current Osiris workshop is a script-only page with no accessible formal credit/cohort detail. Its existence for current BA2 students does not settle requirements for 2026 entrants. No synthetic workshop, unnamed component or elective increment is added. The visible supported subset is175 EC, not a complete valid degree pathway.

audience.programmeDescription: IBCoM at Erasmus studies communication and media from social, cultural, political and economic perspectives, with an international and comparative approach. Students study theory and research methods, develop communication skills, undertake an internship and complete an empirical thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: A complete UCR comparison is withheld because the regulations for students entering in 2026 do not yet establish a consistent 180-EC curriculum. This is a limit in the available curriculum evidence, not a conclusion that UCR offers no suitable study possibilities.

curriculum.routeLabel: 2026 entrants: minor pathway with International Communication & Business and Creative Industries & Audiences
curriculum.limitation: The verified components below account for 175 EC of the 180-EC degree. The remaining 5 EC, including the credit status of the second-year research workshop, requires official clarification. This is an incomplete curriculum, not a certified degree plan.

componentNotes.focus-a: Two 5-EC restricted-choice courses in International Communication & Business.
componentNotes.focus-b: Two 5-EC restricted-choice courses in Creative Industries & Audiences.
componentNotes.minor: 15-EC approved minor; students must be enrolled at least in their third year.
componentNotes.electives: 20 EC of genuine open elective study in one or more secondary fields.
componentNotes.internship: Compulsory 12-EC field-specific internship; all first-year courses must be completed before entry.
componentNotes.thesis: Individual 15-EC empirical thesis. Entry requires first-year completion, at least 30 qualifying later-year EC, both methods courses and the second-year research workshop. Three interim assignments and a draft must be passed/submitted; the workshop credit allocation remains unresolved.
